ops.title: Codex 0.156.1 bounded broker PTY acceptance and missing generation
ops.body: Immutable cc-codex candidate a92992fb5de9adc55012a97e5d8423d749d927bad68d72634c3390caa44b9808 passed exact-version review and a fresh native 0.156.1 TUI thread returned COMPAT_01561_ACK. The actual model tool shell contained CODEX_HOME, matching CODEX_THREAD_ID and CODEX_SESSION_ID, and CODEX_APP_SERVER_WS_URL, but CC_INTERACT_GENERATION was empty; native codex-ask owner resolution stopped before dispatch with exit 2. See the attached report for hashes, commands, evidence paths, cleanup, and scope limits.
